name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Modeling Local Exploit Hazard - A Bayesian Framework for Quantifying Exploit Risk and Operational Efficiency
items.dek: Bayesian framework converts EPSS global probabilities into per-organization daily exploit hazard rates calibrated from telemetry and known-exploited-vulnerabilities timing.
items.unproven: Beta-Binomial inference validation depends on quality of organizational telemetry; applicability across heterogeneous enterprise environments unclear

items.title: CVE-2025-68686 — Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
items.dek: Fortinet FortiOS. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 10 August.

items.title: CVE-2026-16812 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 30 July.

items.title: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? Earned Authority under a Fixed Ceiling for Evolving Agents
items.dek: Formalizes authorization continuity for evolving agents: when tool grants remain valid after a model acquires skills or changes behavior, fixed ceiling and envelope model.
items.unproven: whether state-bound model integrates with existing tool-policy frameworks or requires separate governance layer; no reference implementation

items.title: Isolated but Exposed: Persistence-Based Memory Extraction Attack on LLM Agents
items.dek: Tool interface enables memory exfiltration from isolated LLM agent storage, bypassing user-level isolation.
items.unproven: Validated only on constructed agents; does not cover LLM providers' deployed production mitigations or tool-call rate-limiting in live systems.

items.title: Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra for Taint Confinement in LLM Agents
items.dek: APPA framework uses context branching and prospective label evaluation to enable LLM agents to inspect untrusted data without tainting primary context.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to four model families on single multi-turn benchmark; integration with production SDLC agent pipelines not demonstrated

items.title: ContainmentBench: Trace-Based Evaluation of Post-Injection Containment in Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.dek: ContainmentBench shows 73.5% of prompt-injection defenses with identical zero-harm outcomes differ in logged propagation and authorized-utility completion.
items.unproven: whether trace-based containment metrics translate to security posture in agents entering the SDLC; generalization beyond Qwen2.5-7B

items.title: The Illusion of Secure LLM Code: Closing the Security Gap via Iterative Reprompting
items.dek: Five LLM code assistants fail to generate NIST-compliant authentication code without iterative reprompting; single-shot NIST context alone insufficient.
items.unproven: whether iterative reprompting generalizes to other security domains or remains limited to authentication; tested on five models and one task class

items.title: Do LLMs Know Their Vulnerable Scenarios?
items.dek: Mechanistic interpretability links scenario-wrapped jailbreaks to internal scenario directions; Concept2Scenario framework identifies vulnerable scenario combinations.
items.unproven: generalization to models beyond three tested; whether identified scenarios enable hardening or only explain existing failures

items.title: Experimental Side Channel Analysis of Protocol Stages in Quantum Identity Authentication
items.dek: Beam-splitter side channel on quantum identity authentication reveals protocol stages via photon timing and power without disrupting quantum states.
items.unproven: Whether the attack succeeds at realistic network distances and noise levels; whether the threat applies to deployed quantum networks or testbeds only.

items.title: Experimental Protocol Fingerprinting in Quantum Networks via Physical Layer Side Channel Analysis
items.dek: Four quantum protocols exhibit passive side channel signatures distinguishable via single-photon detection statistics on entangled photon link.
items.unproven: Whether signatures remain distinct in longer-range quantum networks; whether countermeasures are practical; applicability to standard quantum network deployments.

items.title: VulnGym: Evaluating Vulnerability Management Strategies against Advanced Persistent Threats
items.dek: VulnGym simulates RL-trained APT attackers calibrated on real threat profiles against configurable patching policies on real CVEs and networks.
items.unproven: attacker model trained on historical APT profiles; forward applicability to novel attack vectors and zero-day progression untested; network representation fidelity to specific enterprise topology unspecified

items.title: Exploiting Volvo/Eicher's fleet platform to gain control over all users/vehicles
items.dek: Authentication bypass in Volvo/Eicher fleet management platform permits unauthorized control of connected vehicles across user accounts.
items.unproven: Whether vulnerability affects production deployments or only test instances; no public PoC or active exploitation evidence provided; remediation timeline unknown.

items.title: Agentic Cloud Decoys: A Deception-Driven Framework for Autonomous Intrusion Investigation
items.dek: Autonomous agent paired with cloud decoy compresses intrusion investigation by bounding evidence horizon and detecting indirect prompt injection.
items.unproven: reader does not run IR or operate a SOC; evaluation on real breaches or adversary adaptation; scope of false positives in production

items.title: TriShieldRAG: A Three-Ring Defense-in-Depth Framework Against Knowledge Corruption in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.dek: Three-stage defense (ingest filtering, retrieval re-ranking, consensus) reduces RAG poisoning success from 90% to under 10%.
items.unproven: Tested on limited attack scenarios; does not cover adaptive adversaries or measure latency and availability cost at scale.

items.title: Quantum Separability in Polynomial Time
items.dek: Polynomial-time randomized algorithm solves quantum separability problem with constant gap in Euclidean norm.

items.title: ZKP Security Tools and Verification: Coverage, Effectiveness, Adoption, and Challenges
items.dek: Survey of ZKP bug-detection tools finds 45.7% detection on isolated code, 19.6% on full codebases, with Circom dominance and newer DSLs underserved.
items.unproven: effectiveness across production ZKP codebases and whether tool improvements would close the gap or hit fundamental limits

items.title: DMARC Has Been Public Since 2012. 68.4% of Domains Still Don't Enforce It
items.dek: 68.4% of domains do not enforce DMARC despite 12-year availability; survey of adoption gap.
items.unproven: scope and method of domain sample not stated; does not establish why non-adoption persists for this reader's firm

items.title: Residential Proxies Are a National Security Threat
items.dek: Residential proxies enable evasion of network controls; national security concern flagged.
items.unproven: threat model does not directly apply to secure-SDLC or application security engineering decisions

items.title: Quantum Incapacity beyond No-Cloning and PPT Mechanisms
items.dek: Qutrit channel with zero quantum capacity outside PPT and antidegradable classes; resolves quantum information theory open problems, not application security.
items.unproven: entirely outside the reader's domain

items.title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
items.dek: Shaped workload attacks exploit latency deadlines in dual-path inference systems to collapse accuracy of slow-path predictions.
items.unproven: demonstrated only on autonomous driving multi-object tracking; generalization to other inference architectures and defenses untested

items.title: TRACE-CTI: Auditable Post-Extraction Governance of TTP Claims with Knowledge Graphs
items.dek: TRACE-CTI preserves evidence granularity and validation history for automated ATT&CK mappings from threat intelligence reports.
items.unproven: evaluated on 65 reports with controlled extractor matrix; real-world SOC adoption and query-response latency on production-scale corpora untested

items.title: BettiSplit: Topology-Guided Privacy-Aware Split Learning Against Feature Inversion and Gradient Leakage
items.dek: Persistent Betti complexity identifies privacy-critical split points in split learning without executing explicit feature-inversion attacks.
items.unproven: outside reader's remit; split learning is not part of application security engineering or SDLC tooling workflows

items.title: When LLM Defenses Backfire: Characterizing Safety, Performance, and Cost Trade-offs
items.dek: Systematic study of jailbreak defense trade-offs finds rule-based defenses preserve performance best, while self-reflective and multi-round defenses increase over-refusal and latency.
items.unproven: evaluation on representative open-source models; applicability to proprietary closed-source LLMs and domain-specific fine-tuned agents in financial workflows unclear

items.title: DeepFaith: Evidence-Grounded LLMs for Faithful Incident Reporting in Multi-Stage APT Defense
items.dek: DeepFaith generates faithful natural-language APT incident reports by grounding LLM outputs to provenance-graph evidence with post-generation verification.
items.unproven: enterprise testbed evaluation limited to specific autonomous defense system; generalization to heterogeneous SOC tooling and analyst workflows untested

noise.title: About the security content of macOS Tahoe 26.6
noise.dek: Apple security release notes for macOS Tahoe 26.6; routine CVE disclosures.
noise.unproven: standard vendor patch notification; no novel vulnerability class or exploitation technique described

noise.title: Design is compromise
noise.dek: Essay on tradeoffs in design decisions and system constraints.
